_comment: PS5-Utils configuration. Edit and re-run; no code changes needed. Delete this file to fall back to built-in defaults. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.
_repo_comment: Local checkout of ps5rs. Leave empty to clone into a temp directory (no configuration needed, nothing written to your home). Set an explicit path to keep the checkout somewhere permanent. The 'Clone / update ps5rs' action clones it if missing; updates are never automatic.
_data_comment: Paths are resolved relative to repo_path unless absolute. nids.csv is the primary catalog (175k entries); stubs.txt is a secondary source that also supplies library attribution via its '# libSceFoo' headers.
_rename_comment: How resolved names are applied. name_template fields: {name} resolved symbol, {nid} the 11-char NID, {lib} library id, {mod} module id.
_suffix_on_collision_comment: IDA requires unique names. When a resolved name is already taken, append _<nid> rather than silently skipping the rename.
_rename_extern_comment: Rename the import stub slots in the 'extern' segment (these are what call sites actually reference).
_rename_string_refs_comment: Rename the data pointers that reference each NID string.
_comment_original_comment: Record the original NID as a repeatable comment, so the pre-rename identity survives in the database.
_min_confidence_comment: Only apply names whose NID resolved from a source in this list. Empty list = accept any source.
_export_comment: Where reports are written. Relative paths land next to the analyzed binary.
